ticks.note: Tick 1 enters First: counter1.start() sets its counting flag; nothing has been counted: **O1 = 0, O2 = 0**.
First is left (counter1.stop()) and Second entered (counter2.start()); counter1 is stopped before it counts: **O1 = 2, O2 = 0**.
Back to First: counter2 stops, counter1 starts again: **O1 = 2, O2 = 2**.
counter1 resumes from its old value: **O1 = 3**.
